3.content: ... ... The Great Spirit too, which is in it, is like a wise

spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** The Divine Rational proceeding forth [GAP-1] is like a great and sovereign Intelligence whose interior goods and truths of wisdom had been seized away from it. It descended to reclaim what belonged to it. In the same way the [GAP-2] Divine Rational descended after its own truths-born-from-good out of the celestial interiors, so that it might liberate them and recover the wisdom that had been dispersed among the evils and falsities opposing it.

**¶2:** Again, [GAP-3] the Divine Rational is like an Intelligence whose two essential faculties — the will and the understanding — were taken from it by [GAP-4] the dominion of falsity from evil. It] went forth toward them to reclaim them. In the same way the Divine Rational [GAP-5] radiates in the celestial interiors on account of its two faculties, which had been separated from it. These are its interior spiritual life existing in two powers — the volitional and the intellectual — which, in their operation through celestial and spiritual degrees, become four.

**¶3:** Again, the doctrine of illuminated truth [GAP-6] is like a great penetrating power of truth in combat, [GAP-7] and the Divine Proceeding within it is like a sovereign ordering Intelligence] that perfects and rightly disposes [GAP-8] all the truths that serve as protection and means in spiritual combat.

**¶4:** Again, the active Divine Operation is like a warrior who goes forth toward a truth of celestial origin — the heir of the heavenly kingdom — that has been held captive by the hells, and it liberates that truth from the dominion of evils and falsities.

**¶5:** The mediating Divine Principle likewise is like a sovereign Intelligence [GAP-9] proceeding forth on account of the interior goods and truths of wisdom [GAP-10] held in the power of those states of captivity [GAP-11] — that is, these faculties of wisdom and understanding [GAP-12] — the truths-born-from-good and their interior spiritual life, so that they would [GAP-13] be drawn forth and that the interior life might] be liberated out of the state of the natural mind in which it had been imprisoned.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The First [Man] is like a great distinguished man whose treasure has been taken away from him. He came to pursue his treasure. This is how the [First] Man too came after his sons from the heights, so that he might redeem them and retrieve his treasure, which had been scattered amongst his enemies.

Once again, [he is like a man] whose two sons were taken away from him by [his enemies. He] came out toward them to redeem them. Again, this is how the First Man [also] shines in the heights because of his two sons, who were separated from him. They are his living soul that exist in two powers, which makes four.
Once again, the ship [of the day] is like a great spear [ ... ... The Great Spirit too, which is in it, is like a wise ][crafts]man who might beautify and set aright [all] the armour for war.
Once again, the Living Spirit is like a combatant who might go towards a king's son who has been taken prisoner of war, and he redeems him from the hands of his enemies.

[The Amba]ssador too is like a great man [who came forth] because of the treasure [that is in the] hand of his prisoners [that is] these light powers [ ... ... the] sons and their soul, so that they would [be redeemed, and that] be brought forth in the land wherein it was imprisoned.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading confirms "The Divine Rational proceeding forth" which directly corresponds to the Manichaean "First Man," and the surrounding sentence explicitly names this figure.
The spiritual reading confirms "the [GAP-2] Divine Rational descended" mapping to "the First Man" — the standard title used throughout this chapter for this figure.

The spiritual reading confirms "the Divine Rational is like an Intelligence" which maps in the Kephalaia's parabolic register to "he is like a man," following the chapter's consistent simile structure ("is like a...").

The spiritual reading gives "the dominion of falsity from evil" as the agent, which maps to "his enemies" in the Kephalaia's natural register — the same term used in ¶1 ("scattered amongst his enemies") and ¶4 ("the hands of his enemies"); "He" is the visible text beginning the next sentence.

The spiritual reading places no additional content between "Divine Rational" and "radiates," indicating a simple connector; "also" parallels ¶1's use of "too" in the application formula ("the First Man too came...").
The spiritual reading confirms "the doctrine of illuminated truth" which corresponds to the Manichaean "ship of the day" (the sun-ship), the standard cosmological term in the Kephalaia.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading confirms "all the truths that serve as protection" mapping to "all the armour for war" — the universal quantifier is required to express the completeness of the craftsman's work.

The spiritual reading gives "proceeding forth" at this position, which in the Kephalaia's register becomes "who came forth" — paralleling the chapter's repeated pattern of divine figures going out to reclaim what is lost (¶2: "came out toward them," ¶4: "who might go towards").

The spiritual reading gives "held in the power of those states of captivity," which maps to "that is in the hand of his prisoners" — the standard Kephalaia phrasing for treasure/light held captive by the enemy.

The spiritual reading explicitly has "— that is, these faculties of wisdom" at this position, showing an explanatory connector identifying the treasure as the light powers; "that is" is the standard appositional phrase in Kephalaia exposition.

The spiritual reading gives "be drawn forth and that the interior life might," which maps to "be redeemed, and that the soul might" — "redeemed" is the chapter's consistent verb for liberation (¶1, ¶2, ¶4 all use "redeem"), and "and that" provides the conjunction to the soul clause.
